units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 44:22">Targ. Ps. XLIV, 22</cite> (h. text <he>חקר</he>).
Ib. XXVII, 4 ולבשקרה ed. Lag. to find the truth, speculate (ed. ולבקרא, h. text ולבַקֵר).—

<cite ref="Yevamot 120a:11">Yeb. 120ᵃ</cite> he passed before them with a plaster on his face <he>ולא בשקרוה</he> and they (the officers) did not discover it (the disguise; for Var. v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. vv. <cite ref="B00879"><he>בליתא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="B01367"><he>בשקר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Eruvin 19a:10">Erub. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא מְבַשְׁקַר ליה</he> and he (Abraham) does not discover the disguise; Ar. (taking <he>מב׳</he> as part. pass.) and he (in his disguise) is not discovered (as a Jew). *<cite ref="Bekhorot 36b:7">Bekh. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>חזייה בשקריה</he> he saw him, and discovered his fraud, v. Tosaf.; (ed. a. Rashi <he>חזייה בשִׁיקְרֵיה</he> looked at his fraud). [<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 4:34">Targ. Y. II, Deut. IV, 34</cite> <he>לִמְבַשַׁר</he>, Var. <he>למבשׂר</he>, read: <he>לִמְבַשְׁקַר</he>.] V. <cite ref="M00102"><he>מְבַשְׁקְרָנָא</he></cite>.
